Title: 494503-2026: France – Construction work – Design-and-build contract in competitive dialogue for the restructuring of Lycée Jean Rostand in Mantes la Jolie (78)
Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Refurbishment, deconstruction and new construction of a lycée are generally relevant for structural design, as they include dismantling/new construction and structural adaptations. The project is located in France and the size/complexity are unclear, therefore only medium priority for sbp.
titel: Planning and construction contract in competitive dialogue for the restructuring of Lycée Jean Rostand in Mantes-la-Jolie
kurzbeschreibung: Restructuring of a secondary school including planning, conversion, partial new construction, temporary facilities and furnishing.
umfang: Restructuring of Lycée Jean Rostand at the site 66 rue Fernand Bodet, 78200 Mantes-la-Jolie; includes planning and execution services for refurbishment, rehabilitation, partial demolition and reconstruction of individual buildings, regulatory adaptations for accessibility, fire protection, safety as well as energy and environmental performance, reorganisation and optimisation of educational, administrative, technical and functional areas, installation and operation of temporary buildings as well as delivery and relocation management of school furniture; contract term 72 months. No specific areas, gross floor area, spans or structural key figures are stated.
leistungen: Planning and construction services as conception-réalisation; design and execution planning, building construction works, refurbishment, conversion, partial demolition and reconstruction, technical building adaptations, foundation design, engineering services, environmental monitoring, geotechnics, landscaping, furnishing as well as relocation services.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Building construction project with integrated planning component and early involvement via a design-and-build team.
• School construction is generally less core for sbp than bridges, roofs, special structures or sports buildings.
• No information on special structural requirements, large spans or innovative lightweight concepts.
• Extensive overall project with a long duration of 72 months and potentially relevant volume.
• The tender focuses strongly on general contractor/design-build services including fit-out, furnishing and relocation, therefore only limited fit with pure structural engineering expertise.
• Location in France is in principle compatible with sbp’s presence in Paris, but without any recognisable structural particularity only medium priority.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the tender. Essential key figures such as gross floor area, number of buildings to be converted or newly constructed, depth of intervention of the refurbishment and technical standard are missing for a reliable estimate. However, the text indicates a complex school conversion project with partial demolition and reconstruction, temporary buildings, regulatory upgrading and furnishing over 72 months; this tends to indicate a larger project volume in the double-digit million range.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee is stated. A realistic estimate for sbp is not possible, as neither construction costs nor the specifically delineable share of structural or engineering design are mentioned. In addition, this is an integrated planning and construction contract in which the fee is not shown separately.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Suitability criteria according to the tender documents; two-stage procedure with selection of exactly 3 bidders for the second phase. Specific requirements for references or professional qualifications are not stated in the notice itself.
zuschlagskriterien: Not stated in the notice; award via competitive dialogue. Two-stage selection procedure, with at least 3 and at most 3 bidders invited to the second phase.
auftraggeber: Région Île de France represented by RATP Real Estate, Mandataire, 12 AV du Val de Fontenay, 94120 Fontenay sous Bois, France, Contact: Frédéric Fischer, E-Mail: frederic.fischer@ratprealestate.com, Phone: +33 158 772 241, Website: https://www.ratprealestate.com
notes: Notice as competitive dialogue for a planning and construction contract. Submission electronically and in French. No framework agreement. Participation also suitable for SMEs. Tender documents available at https://marches.maximilien.fr/entreprise/consultation/942661?orgAcronyme=t5y.
